subject: Request: credit top-up and temporary rate concession for GlobalWorks pilot
messages:
From: Rachel Sawyer <rachel.sawyer@globalworks.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:14:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot — request for extra credits + short extension

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the smooth onboarding last week. We spun up several experiments and have already burned through the initial pilot credits faster than expected — most usage in NER and summarization tests.

Before we escalate internally, two asks from my side so we can keep momentum into next week: 1) a one-time top-up of 150k tokens of free credits to finish a couple of eval runs; and 2) a two-week extension of the pilot window so our SREs can validate at higher QPS next Tuesday.

We know this is an exception request; if you can loop in pricing and provide a short note we can present to Procurement, that would be ideal. I attached the latest usage export.

Thanks — happy to do a quick call if that helps.

— Rachel
GlobalWorks, Sr. Product Manager
attach: usage_report_may.csv
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Sawyer <rachel.sawyer@globalworks.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:02:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Redwood pilot — request for extra credits + short extension

Ben / Aditya — forwarding GlobalWorks' ask. Quick summary: 
- One-time free credit top-up: 150k tokens
- Pilot extension: +2 weeks
- Customer is high-fit (EU-fintech vertical), POC progressing to paid pilot if we can demonstrate latency at scale.

Procurement will likely want a small commercial concession in parallel; Rachel mentioned they will involve procurement after we confirm what we can offer. Can either of you advise on the maximum approval we can do from AM/pricing for credits and a temporary rate concession?

Attachment: GWorks_SOW.pdf (current SOW, shows planned throughput)

Thanks — Marissa
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 10:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood pilot — request for extra credits + short extension

Marissa — I ran numbers with the pricing team. Here's a recommendation for an exception we can move quickly without Exec sign-off: up to 75k tokens credit and a 1-week extension only. Anything above that triggers manager/exec approval because it materially affects unit economics for the EU region.

Given GlobalWorks' potential (large analytics roadmap), I think we should consider an escalated ask that pairs the credit top-up with a conditional commercial concession: a 20% temporary rate concession for the two-week extended period in exchange for a signed commitment to a paid pilot (min 6 months) or a PO within 30 days. That requires Aditya/Leadership ok.

Suggested motion to exec: grant 150k token top-up + 2-week extension, with a temporary 20% rate concession tied to deal commitment (PO or signed pilot order) within 30 days. If we do not receive the commitment, credits revert to a one-time 75k token cap and we invoice for overage.

I've attached the usage numbers and a draft short concession clause we can include in the SOW.

attach: usage_report_may.csv
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rachel Sawyer <rachel.sawyer@globalworks.com>
Cc: procurement@globalworks.com
Date: Fri, 15 May 2027 16:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: credit top-up and temporary rate concession for GlobalWorks pilot

All — after reviewing the ask and the strategic fit, leadership approves the exception with the following conditions: 

1) Grant a one-time 150,000 token credit top-up to GlobalWorks.
2) Approve a two-week pilot extension.
3) Offer a temporary 20% rate concession that applies only to usage during the extension period, contingent on receiving a signed purchase order or pilot agreement for a minimum 6-month paid pilot within 30 days of concession start.
4) If the commitment is not received within 30 days, the financial team will retroactively invoice the discounted portion and reduce future customer credits to a 75k token cap.

Marissa — please update the SOW and send the concession language to Rachel. Ben, please coordinate with Finance for a tracking tag on the credits so we can reconcile if Procurement doesn't sign. Rachel — we appreciate the fast turnaround; once you confirm acceptance we'll route a short DocuSign for the concession terms.

— Aditya Rao
VP, Global Accounts
Redwood Inference
attach: concession_clause_draft.docx
